Title: Verify authentication failure when providing invalid login credentials
Verify login functionality with valid user credentials (Happy Path)
Verify authentication failure when providing an incorrect password
Comment:
Server returns HTTP/1.1 200 OK and a successful login confirmation message: 

{"Login Response":"Token Already Exists for this user, thus the same Token is Reffered...Login…}


There are also spelling typos in the developer error string ("Reffered" instead of "Referred", and "Sucessfull" instead of "Successful").

During test execution, it was discovered that if a user has an active, valid token session stored on the server, the Login API bypasses password checking entirely. An attacker only needs a valid username to log into a user's account without knowing their credentials.
